ORDER

When the matter is taken up for hearing today, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition. The learned counsel has also made an endorsement to that effect.

2. Recording the said submission and endorsement, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is also closed.
